facts.fact: 一小时后，朱迪思、贝克斯和苏齐坐在救护车尾板上，喝着热茶
facts.anchor: An hour later, Judith, Becks and Suzie were sitting on the tailgate of an ambulance

facts.fact: 派对很快散了，宾客里有医生，Lord Harleyford在等救护车时得到了诊治
facts.anchor: After that, the party had broken up quickly, but there had been doctors present among the guests

facts.fact: 子弹直接穿过了他的肩膀，他侥幸未死
facts.anchor: Fortunately for him, the bullet had passed straight through his shoulder

facts.fact: 朱迪思推断布伦丹找到加里·怀斯，承诺让酒驾车祸的麻烦消失
facts.anchor: I think Brendan approached Gary and told him that he could make the problem go away.

facts.fact: 布伦丹借此勒索加里·怀斯，加里付了钱
facts.anchor: Brendan decided to exploit that. He started to demand money from Gary to keep quiet.

facts.fact: 布伦丹曾说过自己是迈克·萨克森作品的铁杆粉丝，还去听过他的讲座
facts.anchor: He let slip that he was a big fan of Mike Saxon’s writing and had even been to a few of the talks that he’d given

facts.fact: 那位被迈克当众羞辱的作者遭到反击，揭出迈克用代笔的事实
facts.anchor: we can see how insulted that writer would have been.

facts.fact: 苏齐说布伦丹跟着Lord Harleyford下来，追到朱迪思藏身的地方
facts.anchor: It was then just a matter of getting us all down to the spot where you said you’d be hiding.

facts.fact: 贝克斯指出照片里的朱迪思戴着婚戒，这是照片造假的破绽
facts.anchor: it was you, Becks, who worked it out for me. Because you pointed out that I was wearing my wedding ring in the photo.

facts.fact: 朱迪思说菲利波斯不戴婚戒，她那时也不戴
facts.anchor: Philippos wouldn’t wear one, so I didn’t either.

facts.fact: 朱迪思想起照片是自己拍的，于是翻找旧照
facts.anchor: I had a memory that it was me who’d taken the picture of him. So I got out my old photos

facts.fact: 朱迪思记得底片还在，于是翻找底片
facts.anchor: But then I realised I still had all of the negatives of the photos.

facts.fact: 她找到那张底片后震惊，但坚持翻完所有底片才肯想它的含义
facts.anchor: I was stunned. But I refused to think what it could possibly mean until I’d finished hunting through all of my negatives.

facts.fact: 科孚警方在菲利波斯死去当天给栈桥上的朱迪思拍了照
facts.anchor: The Corfu police took photos of me on the jetty – wearing the clothes I was wearing on the day Philippos died.

facts.fact: 科孚警方在全岛散发照片，征集目击者
facts.anchor: They circulated it across the whole island, appealing for witnesses to come forward

facts.fact: 朱迪思说艾勒尼是否真参与了最初那次偷照片，她始终没有完全确定
facts.anchor: So the question of whether she’d in fact been behind the original theft was one I hadn’t entirely resolved.

facts.fact: 布伦丹审讯时说她的秘密被「上了挂锁」，这个用词让朱迪思觉得反常
facts.anchor: During it, he referred to me keeping my secrets “padlocked” away, which struck me as an odd phrase.

facts.fact: 阁楼箱房门上的挂锁被撬开并丢在地上
facts.anchor: the padlock on the door had been forced and left on the floor

facts.fact: 朱迪思用糖粉显出挂锁上四枚清晰的指纹
facts.anchor: I blew icing sugar onto it and revealed that there were four clean fingerprints.

facts.fact: 布伦丹右手食指上有一道很显眼的疤，成了核对指纹的依据
facts.anchor: He has a rather distinctive scar on the forefinger of his right hand.

facts.fact: 朱迪思推断布伦丹是那次度假时去了科孚并取得索菲娅的信任
facts.anchor: I think that that’s when he went to Corfu and won the confidence of Sofia.

facts.fact: 朱迪思断定布伦丹·佩里就是勒索者兼杀人凶手，还在设计陷害她
facts.anchor: Detective Sergeant Brendan Perry was the blackmailer, and the killer, and he was also trying to set me up.

facts.fact: 朱迪思说布伦丹同时勒索球员、贵族与惊悚作家，眼看要超出掌控
facts.anchor: And, if you were Brendan, and you were mixed up in blackmailing a footballer, a lord and a thriller writer, but you were beginning to get out of your depth

facts.fact: 布伦丹在第一起谋杀后立刻让塔妮卡被正式停职，好让自己当上调查者
facts.anchor: He also made sure that Tanika got officially suspended as soon as possible after his first murder.

facts.fact: 结尾朱迪思说她已经回到加莱，可以交代出走后的经历
facts.anchor: But now I’m back, I can tell you all about where I went and what I did after I arrived in Calais.
